title: Improving Environment-Agnostic Coding Agents: The Role of Scaffolding
abstract: arXiv:2610.22289v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Stronger language models may increasingly construct useful procedures for themselves, reducing the advantage of developer-supplied scaffolding. We investigate why this advantage persists and whether an environment-agnostic agent can be improved without environment-specific engineering. We evaluate a Codex-based agent in two nearly identical prompt variants on ARC-AGI-3, AGI Maze, and Terminal-Bench. Each variant is deployed with unchanged code, prompts, and general-purpose tools across environments, receiving environment-specific information as input. Changing only an instruction to encourage reporting difficulties and returning control for automatic continuation improves mean scores on both ARC-AGI-3 and AGI Maze, while Terminal-Bench shows small, mixed changes. Yet the general agent remains below an ARC-AGI-3-specific reference, including with GPT-5.6-sol. The reference prescribes organization and control rather than supplying new game

translated_title: 改进环境无关的编码智能体：脚手架的作用
translated_abstract: 更强的语言模型可能会越来越多地为自己构建有用的操作流程，从而削弱开发者提供的脚手架所带来的优势。我们研究了为什么这种优势会持续存在，以及能否在不进行环境特定工程的情况下改进环境无关的智能体。我们在ARC-AGI-3、AGI Maze和Terminal-Bench上评估了基于Codex的智能体的两个几乎相同的提示变体。每个变体在各环境中部署时均使用不变的代码、提示和通用工具，仅将环境特定信息作为输入。仅改变一条指令——鼓励智能体报告遇到的困难并交还控制权以实现自动继续——就能提高ARC-AGI-3和AGI Maze上的平均得分，而Terminal-Bench则显示出微小的、好坏参半的变化。然而，通用智能体仍然低于ARC-AGI-3专用参考基线，即使使用GPT-5.6-sol也是如此。该参考基线规定的是组织与控制方式，而非提供新的游戏……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 仅通过修改一条提示指令（鼓励报告困难并交还控制权），无需环境特定工程即可提升环境无关编码智能体在ARC-AGI-3和AGI Maze上的表现，但通用智能体仍不及针对单一环境专门设计的基线。
en_tdlr: Modifying only a single prompt instruction—encouraging difficulty reporting and returning control—improves an environment-agnostic coding agent's scores on ARC-AGI-3 and AGI Maze without environment-specific engineering, though it still falls below an environment-specific reference baseline.
